decision.implementation: Retain the request-local exact ngram/MTP composition as explicit default-off functionality with ordinary MTP and AR fallbacks.
decision.measured_premise: Repetition-heavy strict C2/K3 hybrid improves MTP-only 2.425% with every train/heldout prompt positive and exact, proving composition works but K3 is too narrow for the community-scale gains.
decision.product_policy: Reject automatic/default promotion: production D24 has zero hits, strict D80 hybrid remains below true AR, D96 strict has a heldout terminal mismatch, and prior production D120 numerics failed.

long_horizon_blocker.interpretation: AR reaches its terminal suffix at 87 tokens; strict MTP continues to 96. This pre-existing long-horizon mismatch blocks D96 before hybrid economics.
long_horizon_blocker.scope: same code repetition suite, strict C2/K3 D96

next: A product win requires a correctness-qualified long horizon and K>3 target frontier so accepted ngram runs reduce target weight sweeps rather than only replacing NextN scoring. Do not widen automatic policy from this diagnostic.
